title: Dimension of the inverse image of a closed subset under a flat morphism of relative dimension r
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the dimension of the inverse image of a closed subset under a flat morphism of relative dimension r as the dimension of the subset plus r, and shows that an irreducible component of such an inverse image dominates the subset with the same dimension shift (statement lines 2126-2140, tag 02R8). The proof reduces to an integral target with the source replaced by the inverse image, uses that the morphism becomes locally of finite presentation hence open over a locally Noetherian target so that a generic point of an irreducible component maps to the generic point, and then computes the transcendence degree from the dimension of the fibre and the dimension zero local ring. That computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
